events.text: In 2024, through the REALITAS program, PT Vale Indonesia achieved energy savings of 142,529 GJ and increased renewable energy use by 2%, contributing to reduced carbon emissions.
PT Vale Indonesia's 2023 sustainability report reports 2,032,313 ton CO2eq of GHG emissions.
PT Vale Indonesia's 2023 sustainability report sets a target to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 33% by 2030, toward net zero by 2050.
PT Vale Indonesia's 2024 sustainability report reports 31,785,655.01 GJ of energy consumption and 30.6% renewable energy.
PT Vale Indonesia's 2024 sustainability report reports 2,135,742.00 tons of Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions and states Scope 3 has not yet been calculated.
PT Vale Indonesia's 2024 sustainability report adopted a double materiality approach.
In 2025, PTVI faced significant operational challenges including an oil pipeline leak amid market volatility and changing regulatory expectations.

PT Vale secured a US$750 million ESG-linked syndicated loan facility, structured under its Sustainability-Linked Financing Framework and linked to two performance metrics: reducing carbon emissions intensity and increasing renewable energy use.
PT Vale Indonesia secured its first sustainability-linked loan facility worth $750 million.
